recent.text: Final: Wizards 116, Magic 96 George: 24 pts., 3 rebs., 4 assts. Davis: 22 pts., 7 rebs., 1 asst., 2 steals Dybantsa: 16 pts., 8 rebs., 6 assts. Young: 11 pts., 4 rebs., 4 assts. 3-pointers: Wizards 22/39, Magic 12/39
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: The Wizards have extended their lead to 103-81 after Bilal Coulibaly sank his fourth triple of the game. The Magic entered this game willing to have Coulibaly take lots of 3s, but Coulibaly has found his rhythm tonight. He entered today 6-of-36 from deep (17%).
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Bilal Coulibaly has made two of the three 3-pointers he's attempted in the first quarter. It's the first time all season that he's made two triples in a single game.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: The Wizards' injury report for their game Sunday against the Magic has no new inclusions. Reece Beekman, Justin Champagnie, Tristan Vukcevic and Jamir Watkins remain out. For Orlando, Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain) remains out.

recent.text: The Wizards had next-to-nil physicality on defense and minimal on-ball containment during that first half. They allowed only one free throw, and that was on a transition take foul by Trae Young. The Bulls made 56.5 percent of their shot attempts and lead 60-52 at halftime.
recent.author: Josh Robbins

recent.text: Great three-possession sequence there by AJ Dybantsa. He scored from close range. Then he collected a contested defensive rebound. Then he drove and made a wraparound pass to Anthony Davis, who scored and picked up an and-one.
